# Implementation checklist — read before coding

Snapshot: documentation finalized against scaffold on 10 October 2026. This is an explicit
backlog, not a claim the agent works. Update boxes only with test/run evidence.

## Current implementation

PackageAgent v0.2 uses one closing evaluator through both serial and async orchestration.
The async runner journals requests, reconciles and resumes; one hosted D02 crash/restart
completed the same session with zero timeouts. Prep, reporting and the replay viewer execute.
Verified claims are integrated behind NEGOTIATOR_CLAIMS=1, limited to single-supplier
price-increase cases. P01 improved from 80.0 to 92.8 in a two-repeat comparison. Estimates,
MESOs and claims remain off by default; model interpretation/writing is not implemented.
Full final-machine, wave-cap, concurrent-load and Sunday-release rehearsal remains outstanding.
See the [experiment log](../experiments/LOG.md) for exact scopes and limitations.

Only a supplier's standing (first) sheet is directly acceptable on the hosted API. Other
valid sheets are candidate counteroffer packages, not IDs the agent may accept directly.

## Gate A — setup and measured baseline (Runtime + Evaluation)

- [ ] Run root README setup and local checks; record installed kit revision.
- [x] Complete official D01; record serial D02 timing and a one-round concurrent probe.
  See experiment log; sustained concurrency and queued closing remain unverified.
- [ ] Record organizer responses for session queuing, clock start, wave-cap acceptance and units.
- [ ] Agree shared records and module owners in 02 before separate implementations.

## Gate B — economics and closing (Decision + Runtime)

- [ ] Resolve latest quote standards and fixed terms; validate exactly permitted negotiable fields.
- [ ] Compute all C components, must-haves and alternative; handle no alternative explicitly.
- [ ] Per-supplier cost/value estimates with uncertainty for stabilise/secure_supply.
- [ ] Correct exact payment threshold and its current approximation-based test. For the general
  payment comparison, compute both complete costs; x/(1+x) assumes starting at reference terms
  and no other price-linked effects.
- [ ] Margin reference uses cost/(1-m), not cost*(1+m); optimize soft penalty rather than hard floor.
- [x] Shared evaluator handles accept and walk-away, including deadline closure.
- [ ] Reconcile stale/in-flight offers and compare all eligible RFQ packages before closing.

## Gate C — runtime (Runtime)

- [ ] Async client, bounded workers, key-wide limiter, no state locks across awaits.
- [x] Async runner persists logical request ID + exact payload and retries idempotently.
- [ ] Restart reconstructs UTC/server deadlines; does not reuse old monotonic timestamps.
- [ ] Reconcile pending operations, existing sessions and server-counted rounds after errors.
- [ ] End-to-end buyer deadline includes model/parsing/limiter time; bounded fallback.
- [ ] Wave watchdog accounts for queuing; no unvalidated use of kit closing_move.
- [x] CLI dispatches prep/play/run/report. Failure exit-code consistency still needs review.

## Gate D — evidence and model (Evidence + Evaluation)

- [ ] Merge base/release/case context with provenance; include overlay CSVs/documents.
- [ ] Match supplier-specific should-cost rows and price_unit; no double country adjustment.
- [ ] Calendar-aware index windows; unknown data flagged rather than silently zero-filled.
- [ ] Separate external Claim, ProposedTerms and PrivateDecision values.
- [ ] Claim scope ledger includes per-recipient rival quote exception and valid live offer IDs.
- [ ] Unsupported assertion rejected/replaced; ID stripping alone is insufficient.
- [ ] Model receives bounded context; typed reply interpretation is a hypothesis, not authority.
- [ ] Deterministic template reproduces validated packages/claims when model fails.

## Gate E — measured candidate and final readiness (Evaluation + all)

- [ ] Develop against the chosen subset; freeze a holdout before tuning.
- [ ] Compare candidate and baseline with quota-aware repeats and per-case failure analysis.
- [ ] Run concurrent rehearsal and targeted failure tests from 04-experiments.md.
- [ ] Report realized components and aggregate regret separately; no invented optimal components.
- [ ] Produce one replay showing evidence, two candidate packages and actual closing rationale.
- [ ] Sunday overlay + final machine preflight; submit and execute 06-final-runbook.md.

## Scaffold mismatches to fix while implementing

- Shared closing evaluator is now required; obsolete runner fallback removed. Async closing
  uses the same case estimates as the decision policy (explicit runner overrides take precedence).
- guards.check docstring enforces monotonicity and strips IDs: replace with corrected policy.
- claims.build_bank includes weighted decomposition: keep internal unless supported as a checked claim.
- optimizer.payment_breakeven_pct and test currently assert approximation; change together.
- report docstring suggests optimal component regret: output only what actual results support.
- config needs complete model/release wiring; state needs versioning, claim scopes and journal.

Documentation changes do not implement these fixes. Do not mark readiness from passing the
existing scaffold suite alone.

import asyncio

class Clock:
    def utcnow(self):
        return datetime.now(UTC)

    def monotonic(self):
        import time

        return time.monotonic()


@pytest.mark.parametrize("mutation", [None, "foreign_citation", "must_have", "fixed_field", "invalid_price", "garbage"])
def test_model_generates_new_terms_or_uses_certified_fixed_fallback(mutation):
    data = json.loads(DATASET.read_text())
    clock = Clock()
    inputs = recorded_p10(data, message=data["supplier_messages"][0], now=clock.utcnow())
    config = type(
        "Config",
        (),
        {
            "provider_id": "local-fixture",
            "protocol_id": "chat-completions-json-v1",
            "model_id": "explicit-scripted-fixture",
        },
    )()

    class Transport(LocalFixtureTransport):
        async def __call__(self, request, budget):
            if request.task != "propose":
                return await super().__call__(request, budget)
            terms = {**data["candidate_terms"][0], "unit_price": 30.01}
            if mutation == "must_have":
                terms["volume_per_year"] = 16379
            if mutation == "fixed_field":
                terms["payment_days"] = 30
            if mutation == "invalid_price":
                terms["unit_price"] = 30.001
            from negotiator.v2.adapters.p10 import term_binding

            raw = (
                json.dumps(
                    {
                        "bindings": [term_binding(k, v) for k, v in terms.items()],
                        "citation_ids": ["citation:forged"] if mutation == "foreign_citation" else [],
                        "rationale": "Test new legal proposal.",
                    }
                )
                if mutation != "garbage"
                else "not JSON"
            )
            return m.ModelSuccess(
                kind="success",
                call_id=request.call_id,
                model_id=request.model_id,
                elapsed_s=Decimal("0"),
                issues=(),
                raw_response_json=raw,
                response_hash=hashlib.sha256(raw.encode()).hexdigest(),
                usage=m.ModelUsage(),
            )

    assembler, coordinator = bounded_services(inputs, clock, Transport(), config, prompt_revision="v3", arm="adaptive")
    trace = asyncio.run(run_recorded_decision(inputs, assembler=assembler, coordinator=coordinator))
    trace.verify()
    assert trace.validation.kind == "valid"
    call = next(c for c in trace.model_calls if c.request.task == "propose")
    if mutation is None:
        assert call.consumer_admitted is True
        assert trace.rendered.payload.packages[0].fingerprint not in {p.fingerprint for p in inputs.packages}
    else:
        assert call.fallback_used and call.permitted_raw_response is None
        assert trace.rendered.payload.packages[0].fingerprint in {p.fingerprint for p in inputs.packages}
        assert any(i.component == "strategy.proposal" for i in trace.issues)
    projection = call.request.input.model_dump_json()
    assert "fallback_unit_price" not in projection and "relationship_eur_per_point" not in projection


def test_adaptive_control_closes_and_is_visible_through_normal_lab_store(tmp_path):
    report = run_local(tmp_path, arms=("minimum", "adaptive"))
    baseline, adaptive = report["runs"]
    assert baseline["status"] == adaptive["status"] == "completed"
    assert adaptive["deal"] is True and adaptive["rounds"] >= 2
    paths = sorted((tmp_path / "traces" / adaptive["run_id"]).glob("*/decision-*.json"))
    traces = [OfflineDecisionTrace.model_validate_json(p.read_bytes()) for p in paths]
    assert len({t.rendered.payload.packages[0].fingerprint for t in traces}) >= 2
    for trace in traces:
        trace.verify()
        assert trace.validation.kind == "valid"
    assert all(
        msg.speaker in {"buyer", "supplier", "arena"}
        for msg in m.DecisionSnapshot.model_validate_json(traces[-1].snapshot_bytes).conversation.messages
    )
    terminal = json.loads(
        next((tmp_path / "traces" / adaptive["run_id"]).glob("*/terminal-observation.json")).read_text()
    )
    assert terminal["terminal"]["deal"] is True and terminal["terminal"]["offer_id"]
    store = Store(tmp_path / "lab.sqlite3")
    for _, run in load_snapshots(tmp_path / "runs"):
        store.upsert(run)
    assert len(store.listing()["runs"]) == 2
    assert store.get(adaptive["run_id"])["attempts"][0]["result"]["deal"] is True
    assert store.comparison(baseline["run_id"], adaptive["run_id"]) is not None


def test_uncertain_submission_survives_restart_and_reconciles_without_retry(tmp_path):
    messages = [{"from": "supplier", "body": "standing"}]
    posts = []
    payload = {"body": "validated", "term_sheets": []}

    def handle(request):
        if request.method == "POST":
            posts.append(request)
            messages.append({**payload, "from": "buyer"})
            messages.append({"from": "supplier", "body": "reply"})
            raise httpx.ReadTimeout("uncertain", request=request)
        if str(request.url).endswith("/threads/supplier:test"):
            return httpx.Response(200, json={"messages": messages})
        return httpx.Response(200, json={"status": "open"})

    journal = tmp_path / "requests.jsonl"
    client = JournaledArena(journal, base_url="http://localhost", rate=100)
    client.http.close()
    client.http = httpx.Client(base_url="http://localhost/v1", transport=httpx.MockTransport(handle))
    with pytest.raises(RecoveryRequired):
        client.send_message("session:test", "supplier:test", payload)
    pending = client.journal.pending()[0]
    assert posts[0].headers["X-Move-Id"] == pending["move_id"]
    assert posts[0].content.decode() == pending["payload_utf8"]
    client.http.close()
    restarted = JournaledArena(journal, base_url="http://localhost", rate=100)
    restarted.http.close()
    restarted.http = httpx.Client(base_url="http://localhost/v1", transport=httpx.MockTransport(handle))
    with pytest.raises(RecoveryRequired):
        restarted.send_message("session:test", "supplier:test", payload)
    assert len(posts) == 1
    assert restarted.reconcile_pending()[0]["status"] == "acknowledged"
    assert not restarted.journal.pending() and len(posts) == 1
    restarted.http.close()


def test_hosted_allowance_rejects_source_or_budget_changes_before_credentials(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    from experiments.v2.run_adaptive_milestone import execute, plan

    monkeypatch.delenv("LLM_API_KEY", raising=False)
    approved = {**plan(), "authorized": True, "token_accounting_confirmed": True}
    approved["max_calls"] += 1
    authorization = tmp_path / "approval.json"
    authorization.write_text(json.dumps(approved))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="exactly match"):
        execute(tmp_path / "run", authorization)
    assert not (tmp_path / "run").exists()
    assert not authorization.with_name(authorization.name + ".consumed").exists()


def test_online_factory_requires_exact_allowance_and_verified_live_clocks(tmp_path):
    from experiments.v2.run_adaptive_milestone import CONFIG
    from negotiator.v2.core.errors import ContractViolation
    from negotiator.v2.core.serialization import semantic_hash
    from negotiator.v2.factory import online_lab_agent

    dataset = json.loads(DATASET.read_text())

    class FakeGuard:
        max_calls, max_usd = 18, Decimal("1.00")

    kwargs = dict(dataset_path=DATASET, trace_root=tmp_path, transport=FakeGuard(), model_config=CONFIG)
    with pytest.raises(ContractViolation, match="approval"):
        online_lab_agent(**kwargs, execution_allowance={})
    allowance = dict(
        authorized=True,
        environment="practice",
        online_sessions=1,
        retries=0,
        max_calls=18,
        max_total_reserved_tokens=1769472,
        max_usd="1.00",
        offline_verification=True,
        remote_lab_verified=True,
        case_hash=semantic_hash(dataset["case"]),
        model_id=CONFIG.model_id,
    )
    agent = online_lab_agent(**kwargs, execution_allowance=allowance)
    agent.validate_lab_case(dataset["case"])
    altered = {**dataset["case"], "round_limit": 11}
    with pytest.raises(ContractViolation, match="reviewed"):
        agent.validate_lab_case(altered)
    agent.observe_lab_session("run:readiness-test", "session:offline-p10")
    clock = Clock()
    inputs = recorded_p10(dataset, message=dataset["supplier_messages"][0], now=clock.utcnow())
    raw = {
        "session_id": "session:offline-p10",
        "case_id": "case:P10",
        "status": "open",
        "rounds": 0,
        "threads": {dataset["case"]["suppliers"][0]: {"offer_id": None, "seconds_left": 40}},
    }
    agent.observe_lab_server_state(raw, requested_at=clock.utcnow(), received_at=clock.utcnow())
    normalized = agent.normalize_live_inputs(inputs, dataset["case"]["suppliers"][0])
    assert normalized.server.threads[0].rounds.confidence == "authoritative"
    assert normalized.server.threads[0].clock.confidence == "conservative"
    raw["rounds"] = None
    with pytest.raises(ContractViolation, match="rounds/clock"):
        agent.normalize_live_inputs(inputs, dataset["case"]["suppliers"][0])

class FieldOrigin(FrozenModel):
    field: TermField
    source_kind: Literal["sheet", "fixed", "quote", "master", "buyer_default"]
    source_refs: tuple[SourceRef, ...]

    @field_validator("source_refs")
    @classmethod
    def required_origin(cls, value):
        if not value:
            raise ValueError("every field needs a source origin")
        return value


def _check_origins(bindings, origins):
    fields = tuple(t.field for t in bindings)
    origin_fields = tuple(t.field for t in origins)
    if len(set(fields)) != len(fields) or len(set(origin_fields)) != len(origin_fields):
        raise ValueError("term bindings and origins must be unique")
    if set(fields) != set(origin_fields):
        raise ValueError("each term must have exactly one origin")


class ResolvedTerms(FrozenModel):
    bindings: tuple[TermBinding, ...]
    origins: tuple[FieldOrigin, ...]
    version_hash: str

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def consistent_origins(self):
        _check_origins(self.bindings, self.origins)
        return self


class ResolvedStandards(FrozenModel):

def verify_lab_access(url):
    if os.environ.get("LAB_URL", "").rstrip("/") != url.rstrip("/") or not os.environ.get("LAB_UPLOAD_TOKEN"):
        raise ValueError("Lab credentials/destination differ from the explicit allowance")
    with httpx.Client(timeout=30, follow_redirects=False) as client:
        response = client.get(url.rstrip("/") + "/api/runs",
                              headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + os.environ["LAB_UPLOAD_TOKEN"]})
        response.raise_for_status()
        if not isinstance(response.json().get("runs"), list):
            raise ValueError("normal Lab listing unavailable")


def publish_verified(run, url, output):
    # One final PUT only. No publisher thread or retry; all evidence is already captured.
    if not upload(run, url, os.environ["LAB_UPLOAD_TOKEN"], timeout=30):
        raise ValueError("Lab publication failed; preserve this run, do not repeat negotiation")
    with httpx.Client(base_url=url.rstrip("/"), timeout=30, follow_redirects=False,
                      headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + os.environ["LAB_UPLOAD_TOKEN"]}) as client:
        listing = client.get("/api/runs")
        listing.raise_for_status()
        response = client.get("/api/runs/" + run.run_id)
        response.raise_for_status()
        body = response.json()
        if body != run.model_dump() or run.run_id not in {r["run_id"] for r in listing.json()["runs"]}:
            raise ValueError("Lab retrieval does not exactly match the completed evidence")
        proof = {"lab_url": url, "run_id": run.run_id, "retrieval_verified": True,
                 "listing_verified": True, "run": body}
        _atomic_file(output / ("lab-proof-" + run.run_id + ".json"), json.dumps(proof, indent=2))
    return proof


def dataset_for(case):
    if case["case_id"] not in {"case:D01", "case:D02", "case:P10"} or len(case["parts"]) != 1:
        raise ValueError("unsupported hosted case/part count")
    # Baseline is a legal buyer-plan package, not a simulator-specific bargaining rule.
    buyer = case["buyer"]
    preferred = {"unit_price": buyer.get("current_unit_price") or buyer["fallback_unit_price"],
                 "payment_days": buyer["reference_payment_days"], "lead_time_days": buyer["need_lead_time_days"],
                 "incoterm": "DAP", "contract_months": round(12 * buyer["horizon_years"]),
                 "volume_per_year": buyer["need_per_year"]}
    terms = {}
    for field in case["negotiable"]:
        choices = case["term_options"].get(field)
        value = preferred.get(field)
        terms[field] = value if not choices or value in choices else choices[0]
    if not must_haves_ok(case, terms):
        raise ValueError("buyer-plan baseline violates must-haves; explicit case support needed")
    return {"case": case, "price_unit": 1, "supplier_messages": [], "candidate_terms": [terms],
            "price_basis_source": "official case briefing: EUR per unit; single part",
            "estimate_limit": "supplier full-cost estimates unavailable; relationship component explicitly unestimated"}


def prior_review(path, stage):
    review = json.loads(path.read_text())
    predecessor = STAGES[stage][3]
    required = {"stage": predecessor, "transcript_reviewed": True, "blocking_issues_resolved": True,
                "genuine_hosted_model": True, "lab_retrieval_verified": True}
    if any(review.get(key) != value for key, value in required.items()):
        raise ValueError("prior stage actual transcript and blockers must be reviewed first")
    for artifact in review.get("artifacts", []):
        p = Path(artifact["path"])
        if hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != artifact["sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("prior reviewed artifact changed")
    if not review.get("artifacts"):
        raise ValueError("review requires actual original evidence artifacts")
    return semantic_hash(review)


def plan(stage, dataset, lab_url, prior_review_hash=None):
    environment, calls, dollars, predecessor = STAGES[stage]
    return {"authorized": False, "token_accounting_confirmed": False,
            "stage": stage, "case": "case:" + stage, "case_hash": semantic_hash(dataset["case"]),
            "dataset_hash": semantic_hash(dataset), "environment": environment,
            "arena_url": "https://arena.tacto.ai", "online_sessions": 1, "remote_writes": 1,
            "lab_url": lab_url, "model_config": asdict(CONFIG), "model_id": CONFIG.model_id,
            "strategy": "bounded-proposal-v1", "max_calls": calls, "max_usd": dollars,
            "max_total_reserved_tokens": calls * PER_CALL_TOKENS,
            "max_output_tokens": CONFIG.max_output_tokens, "retries": 0, "automatic_reruns": 0,
            "source_sha256": offline_plan()["source_sha256"], "prior_stage": predecessor,
            "prior_review_hash": prior_review_hash, "offline_verification": True, "remote_lab_verified": True,
            "token_accounting": offline_plan()["token_accounting"],
            "supplier_estimates": dataset.get("estimate_limit"),
            "review_required": "complete predecessor transcript, semantic quality, fallbacks, economics and blockers"}


class SingleSessionArena(JournaledArena):
    def __init__(self, path, case_id, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(path, **kwargs)
        self.case_id = case_id

    def _call(self, method, path, body=None, params=None, raw=False):
        if method == "POST" and path == "/sessions":
            if body != {"case_id": self.case_id} or self.journal.sessions() or self.journal.pending():
                raise ValueError("one exact authorized session only; no reopen or retry")
        return super()._call(method, path, body, params, raw)


def execute(output, authorization, stage, dataset, lab_url, review_path):
    review_hash = prior_review(review_path, stage)
    expected = plan(stage, dataset, lab_url, review_hash)
    approved = json.loads(authorization.read_text())
    if approved != {**expected, "authorized": True, "token_accounting_confirmed": True}:
        raise ValueError("exact source/case/session/inference/Lab-write authorization required")
    load_env()
    if not os.environ.get("LLM_API_KEY") or not os.environ.get("ARENA_API_KEY"):
        raise ValueError("hosted credentials missing")
    if os.environ.get("ARENA_URL", "https://arena.tacto.ai").rstrip("/") != approved["arena_url"]:
        raise ValueError("Arena destination differs from explicit authorization")
    verify_lab_access(lab_url)
    if output.exists():
        raise ValueError("fresh output required; no automatic restart/rerun")
    output.mkdir(parents=True, mode=0o700)
    marker = authorization.with_name(authorization.name + ".consumed")
    with os.fdopen(os.open(marker, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL, 0o600), "w") as stream:
        stream.write(semantic_hash(approved))
        stream.flush()
        os.fsync(stream.fileno())
    _atomic_file(output / "approved-plan.json", json.dumps(approved, indent=2))
    _atomic_file(output / "dataset.json", json.dumps(dataset, indent=2))
    allowance = OfflineAllowance(output, max_calls=approved["max_calls"], max_usd=Decimal(approved["max_usd"]))
    client = SingleSessionArena(output / "arena-journal.jsonl", approved["case"],
                                base_url=approved["arena_url"], api_key=os.environ["ARENA_API_KEY"], timeout=180)
    try:
        me = client.me()
        cases = client.cases(approved["environment"])
        actual = next((case for case in cases if case["case_id"] == approved["case"]), None)
        if me.get("status") != "active" or actual != dataset["case"]:
            raise ValueError("current permissions/case differ from reviewed readiness")
        if stage == "P10" and (actual.get("hosted") is not True or me.get("practice", {}).get("left", 0) < 1):
            raise ValueError("practice case/quota unavailable")
        if client.journal.pending():
            raise ValueError("unresolved submission; read-only reconciliation required")
        _atomic_file(output / "preflight.json", json.dumps({"me": me, "case": actual}, indent=2))
        agent = online_lab_agent(dataset_path=output / "dataset.json", trace_root=output / "traces",
                                 transport=allowance, model_config=CONFIG, execution_allowance=approved)
        provenance, patch = capture_provenance(PROJECT, data_dir=output, allow_dirty=True)
        run = plan_run(name="V2 hosted " + stage, author="authorized-v2-validation",
            hypothesis="Real citation-grounded adaptive proposals negotiate using complete official observations.",
            agent="negotiator.v2.factory:online_lab_agent", config={"execution_plan_json": json.dumps(approved)},
            cases=[approved["case"]], repetitions=1, max_sessions=1, environment=approved["environment"],
            arena_url=approved["arena_url"], provenance=provenance)
        final = run_experiment(run, output / "runs", client, lambda: agent, patch=patch)
        # Publish original failed attempts too. A failure never authorizes a replacement session.
        publish_verified(final, lab_url, output)
        if final.status != "completed" or allowance.stopped or client.journal.pending():
            raise ValueError("hosted stage failed or uncertain; review original evidence before proceeding")
        _atomic_file(output / "review-required.json", json.dumps({"stage": stage,
            "transcript_reviewed": False, "blocking_issues_resolved": False, "genuine_hosted_model": True,
            "lab_retrieval_verified": True, "artifacts": []}, indent=2))
    finally:
        client.http.close()


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--stage", choices=STAGES, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--metadata", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--lab-url", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--out", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--prior-review", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--authorization", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    metadata = json.loads(args.metadata.read_text())
    environment = STAGES[args.stage][0]
    case = next(c for c in metadata["cases?set=" + environment] if c["case_id"] == "case:" + args.stage)
    dataset = dataset_for(case)
    review_hash = prior_review(args.prior_review, args.stage) if args.prior_review else None
    if args.authorization:
        if not args.prior_review:
            raise ValueError("prior actual transcript review required before execution")
        execute(args.out, args.authorization, args.stage, dataset, args.lab_url, args.prior_review)
    else:
        args.out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        _atomic_file(args.out / "dataset.json", json.dumps(dataset, indent=2))
        _atomic_file(args.out / "authorization-template.json", json.dumps(
            plan(args.stage, dataset, args.lab_url, review_hash), indent=2))
        print("Prepared " + args.stage + "; inference=0; sessions=0; Lab writes=0; predecessor review required")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Hosted adapter conformance using ONLY in-process official Sim and mock inference.

These tests open no hosted sessions, make no inference calls, and publish no Lab records.
"""

import hashlib

class MockInference(LocalFixtureTransport):
    def __init__(self, stage):
        self.max_calls = STAGES[stage][1]
        self.max_usd = Decimal(STAGES[stage][2])
        self.calls, self.reserved, self.stopped = [], Decimal(0), False

    async def __call__(self, request, budget):
        self.calls.append({'task': request.task, 'mock_only': True})
        if request.task != 'propose':
            return await super().__call__(request, budget)
        source = request.input
        latest = next(sheet for msg in reversed(source.conversation.messages) if msg.speaker == 'supplier'
                      for sheet in msg.observed_sheets if sheet.standing)
        terms = {t.field: t.value for t in latest.complete_bindings}
        terms['unit_price'] = (terms['unit_price'] * Decimal('0.97')).quantize(Decimal('0.01'))
        for option in source.options:
            if terms.get(option.field) not in option.values:
                terms[option.field] = option.values[0]
        raw = json.dumps({'bindings': [term_binding(k, terms[k]) for k in source.negotiable_fields],
                          'citation_ids': [source.citation_catalog[-1][0]], 'rationale': 'Mock contract test only.'})
        return m.ModelSuccess(kind='success', call_id=request.call_id, model_id=request.model_id,
            elapsed_s=Decimal(0), issues=(), raw_response_json=raw,
            response_hash=hashlib.sha256(raw.encode()).hexdigest(), usage=m.ModelUsage())


def agent_for(tmp_path, case):
    stage = case['case_id'].split(':')[1]
    dataset = dataset_for(case)
    path = tmp_path / 'dataset.json'
    path.write_text(json.dumps(dataset))
    allowance = {**plan(stage, dataset, 'https://lab.example'), 'authorized': True, 'token_accounting_confirmed': True}
    agent = online_lab_agent(dataset_path=path, trace_root=tmp_path / 'traces', model_config=CONFIG,
                             transport=MockInference(stage), execution_allowance=allowance)
    return agent


@pytest.mark.parametrize('case', CASES, ids=['D01', 'D02'])
def test_multisupplier_adapter_tracks_complete_original_evidence_before_finishing(tmp_path, case):
    agent = agent_for(tmp_path, case)

    class Simulator(InProcessSimulatorClient):
        def cases(self, set_):
            assert set_ == 'sandbox'
            return [case]

    client = Simulator(case)
    run = plan_run(name='Mock hosted-adapter conformance, local Sim ONLY', author='test', hypothesis='Contract test',
        agent='mock-test-only', config={'model_config': asdict(CONFIG)}, cases=[case['case_id']], repetitions=1,
        max_sessions=1, environment='sandbox', arena_url='http://localhost', provenance={})
    published = []

    class PublisherSpy:
        def submit(self, snapshot):
            # Real publisher copies; retain copies to check completion ordering.
            published.append(type(snapshot).model_validate(snapshot.model_dump()))

        def close(self):
            pass

    final = run_experiment(run, tmp_path / 'runs', client, lambda: agent, publisher=PublisherSpy())
    assert final.status == 'completed', final.model_dump()
    result = final.attempts[0].result
    assert result['agent_evidence']['terminal_json']
    assert not result['agent_evidence'].get('evidence_truncated')
    assert all('agent_evidence' in r.attempts[0].result and r.attempts[0].threads
               for r in published if r.attempts[0].status == 'completed')
    assert set(final.attempts[0].threads) == set(case['suppliers'])
    assert all(t.validation.kind == 'valid' for t in agent.traces)
    assert all(c['mock_only'] for c in agent.transport.calls)
    assert all(sid in agent.supplier_memory for sid in case['suppliers'])
    assert all(t.evaluations.items[0].economic[0].basis_verified for t in agent.traces)
    store = Store(tmp_path / 'lab.sqlite3')
    for _, snapshot in load_snapshots(tmp_path / 'runs'):
        store.upsert(snapshot)
    assert store.get(final.run_id)['attempts'][0]['result']['agent_evidence'] == result['agent_evidence']


def test_d02_contract_preserves_executable_alternative_in_each_economic_slice():
    case = CASES[1]
    dataset = dataset_for(case)
    scoped = {**dataset, 'case': {**case, 'suppliers': [case['suppliers'][1]]}, 'supplier_messages': ['Public quote']}
    inputs = recorded_p10(scoped, message='Public quote', now=datetime.now(UTC))
    assert inputs.case.supplier_ids == (case['suppliers'][1],)
    assert inputs.case.buyer.current_price is None

def execute(output, authorization, lab_url=None):

    load_env()

    if not os.environ.get("LLM_API_KEY"):
        raise ValueError("LLM_API_KEY missing")
    output.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    # This authorization is single-use across output directories and process restarts.
    marker = authorization.with_name(authorization.name + ".consumed")
    with os.fdopen(os.open(marker, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL, 0o600), "w") as stream:
        stream.write(semantic_hash(approved))
        stream.flush()
        os.fsync(stream.fileno())
    _atomic_file(output / "approved-plan.json", json.dumps(approved, indent=2))
    allowance = OfflineAllowance(output)
    asyncio.run(interpretations(output, allowance))
    if allowance.stopped:

    dataset = json.loads(DATASET.read_text())
    provenance, patch = capture_provenance(PROJECT, data_dir=PROJECT / "tests/fixtures/v2", allow_dirty=True)
    for arm in ("minimum", "adaptive"):
        config = {
            "dataset_path": str(DATASET),

+# Hosted sandbox validation before practice — 11 October 2026
+
+The execution order is now offline GPT-4.1-mini validation, D01 sandbox, D02 sandbox,
+then P10 practice. Each hosted stage requires fresh explicit approval of inference,
+one Arena session and one final Lab publication. No previous approval is reused.
+No hosted inference calls, hosted sessions or remote Lab writes were made during this update.
+
+## Implemented and tested
+
+The existing V2 Lab adapter supports the reviewed D01 price-increase and D02 two-supplier
+RFQ contracts as well as P10. It maintains separate assessments and acknowledged histories
+per supplier and schedules live bidders serially. The adaptive model receives the target's
+complete history and observed rival packages for internal comparison. Deterministic scheduling
+does not substitute for the model's interpretation or proposal generation. Rendering continues
+to send independently validated own packages; rival-price disclosure is not enabled by these notes.
+
+Economics retains the one-part/one-supplier oracle: D02 proposal evaluation uses a faithful
+target-specific economic slice. The D02 executable alternative quote is preserved in each slice.
+The shared case coordinator independently compares every live standing offer and the alternative
+when closing. Quote standards are parsed with the official reader and retained as explicitly
+scoped current quote evidence with attachment provenance. The resolver opt-in admits only
+declared session quote records with the official quote parser; default unsupported-layer behavior
+and all grounding/economic/action validators remain intact.
+
+The Lab runner refreshes all bidder histories and documents before observing clocks. Global RFQ
+round counts must exactly match all acknowledged buyer messages before a new proposal is admitted;
+unassignable timeouts stop execution. Closing checks current offer ownership and every live bidder.
+Model interruption stops further decisions and submissions. Exact payloads and move IDs remain
+durable before POST. One-session transport prevents reopening even after a definite rejection and
+restricts messages to the owned session's supplier endpoints. Uncertain opens or messages stop;
+read-only exact-history reconciliation is available, without automatic retries or session guessing.
+
+Completed Lab attempts are now finalized only after terminal observations, complete thread retrieval,
+decision/economic records and inference evidence are captured. V2 fails the completion gate if
+required evidence is truncated. The authorized stage runner uploads the final record once, then
+checks exact retrieval and normal listing. It publishes the original failed record too; upload
+failure never permits a replacement negotiation. The offline interpretation gate is persisted in
+the normal Lab snapshots even if it fails before either simulator session starts.
+
+The stage runner is `experiments/v2/run_hosted_sandbox.py`, composed around the existing
+`plan_run`/`run_experiment`, V2 factory, journal and Lab publication APIs. Its default operation
+only writes local review templates. The paid offline runner is
+`experiments/v2/run_adaptive_milestone.py`; it now includes explicit final publication allowances,
+normal Lab evidence for the development interpretation evaluation and failed-gate persistence.
+
+## Read-only readiness evidence
+
+`/tmp/v2-sandbox-readiness-2026-10-11.json` records official case catalogs and team status.
+The key is active, D01/D02 are available through the sandbox catalog, and P10 is hosted for
+practice. The observed practice quota was 286 remaining of 600. These are observations, not
+reservations; all permissions, catalogs and quotas must be refreshed immediately before execution.
+
+`/tmp/v2-hosted-access-readiness-2026-10-11.json` records successful HTTP 200 checks for the
+configured Lab listing and the exact model metadata. Current configured Lab destination:
+`https://66-201-6-11.sslip.io/`. No credential values are saved. Model metadata access does not
+prove completion latency or account billing headroom; the explicit call/token/dollar guard controls
+the experiment and stops on failures.
+
+The Lab recommendation remains `e1d931e4fcce49fb8fd341c40052953a`, generation 1, for
+`d01-d02-sandbox-serial-v1`. Existing findings reject global stronger anchoring and the measured
+payment-response candidate. This standalone intelligence validation does not change that recommendation.
+
+## Authorization sequence
+
+Local preparation artifacts live under `/tmp/v2-hosted-sandbox-preparation-2026-10-11/`.
+Every authorization is source-bound, exact-match and single-use. All four templates are initially
+unauthorized. Hosted draft templates have no predecessor review hash and cannot execute as prepared.
+
+| Stage | Maximum inference calls | Reserved total tokens | USD ceiling | Arena sessions | Final Lab writes |
+| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- | ---: |
+| Offline | 32 | 3,145,728 | 2.00 | 0 hosted; 2 in-process Sim | 2 |
+| D01 | 18 | 1,769,472 | 1.00 | 1 sandbox | 1 |
+| D02 | 36 | 3,538,944 | 2.00 | 1 sandbox | 1 |
+| P10 | 18 | 1,769,472 | 1.00 | 1 practice | 1 |
+
+All stages use `gpt-4.1-mini-2025-04-14`, structured outputs, 2,048 output tokens per call,
+zero retries and zero automatic reruns. Reservation uses a conservative UTF-8-byte upper bound
+plus schema and framing allowance. That accounting convention requires explicit confirmation.
+Pricing assumptions were verified against [official OpenAI model documentation](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-4.1-mini):
+USD 0.40/M input and USD 1.60/M output. The offline conservative reservation is USD 1.3369344;
+USD 2 is the approved maximum, not a claim of actual expenditure.
+
+First request approval only for `offline/authorization-template.json`: 14 development
+interpretations, the existing fixed baseline and one genuine adaptive official-Sim negotiation,
+with two final Lab records published to the exact configured destination. Its decision traces,
+development predictions, interpretation evaluation, economics and inference ledger are retained.
+The provisional development gate requires at least 12 semantically correct examples of 14;
+independent transcript review is still required before hosted execution.
+
+Before D01, review the actual offline transcript and Lab proof. Before D02, review the original
+D01 transcript, fallbacks, economics, deadline behavior and outcome, then resolve blockers.
+Before P10, do the same for D02. A prior-review artifact must bind original files by hashes and
+include the exact adaptive predecessor's Lab retrieval proof, admitted interpretation/proposal
+evidence and correct environment/case/terminal state. Rebuild the next stage's allowance around
+that review hash and request a fresh explicit authorization. There is no automatic stage chain.
+
+## Validation and remaining limitations
+
+Full V2 suite after adapter changes: **1,263 passed, 298 expected xfailed**. The new D01/D02
+conformance tests exercise the official in-process Sim with mock inference, both bidder histories,
+executable alternative preservation, validated proposals, terminal evidence and Lab Store retrieval.
+After runner/script updates: **17 focused adaptive/hosted tests passed**. Lab runner regression
+suite: **32 passed**, using a local loopback test server. Scoped Ruff and `git diff --check` pass.
+These checks are not hosted negotiation or persuasion evidence. The previously documented unrelated
+legacy context failure remains outside this change; no full-repository pass is claimed.
+
+D01 full-cost supplier estimates are unavailable in the loaded public package. The official
+relationship formula is retained, but its nominal component is explicitly unestimated when the
+oracle receives no supplier estimate. Do not infer hidden costs or claim sustainable margins or
+complete realized-cost accuracy from that nominal projection; review the actual Arena breakdown.
+The model is told the category goal and that hidden supplier full costs are unknown.
+
+RFQ scheduling is serial. Real supplier reply latency may exhaust another bidder's independent
+clock; conservative checks stop or close on current validated evidence. Concurrent supplier
+orchestration is not claimed. Multipart cases, automatic process restart/resume, foreign/unowned
+session recovery, general claim-based persuasion and automatic Lab-upload retry are not implemented.
+Generalization and behavior comparisons across environments await the actual authorized sequence.
+
+Arena contracts were reviewed in the [official API documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tacto-ai/negotiation-arena-kit/main/brief/api.md).
+No final cases or spectator endpoints are used.

# Hosted sandbox validation before practice — 11 October 2026

The execution order is now offline GPT-4.1-mini validation, D01 sandbox, D02 sandbox,
then P10 practice. Each hosted stage requires fresh explicit approval of inference,
one Arena session and one final Lab publication. No previous approval is reused.
No hosted inference calls, hosted sessions or remote Lab writes were made during this update.

## Implemented and tested

The existing V2 Lab adapter supports the reviewed D01 price-increase and D02 two-supplier
RFQ contracts as well as P10. It maintains separate assessments and acknowledged histories
per supplier and schedules live bidders serially. The adaptive model receives the target's
complete history and observed rival packages for internal comparison. Deterministic scheduling
does not substitute for the model's interpretation or proposal generation. Rendering continues
to send independently validated own packages; rival-price disclosure is not enabled by these notes.

Economics retains the one-part/one-supplier oracle: D02 proposal evaluation uses a faithful
target-specific economic slice. The D02 executable alternative quote is preserved in each slice.
The shared case coordinator independently compares every live standing offer and the alternative
when closing. Quote standards are parsed with the official reader and retained as explicitly
scoped current quote evidence with attachment provenance. The resolver opt-in admits only
declared session quote records with the official quote parser; default unsupported-layer behavior
and all grounding/economic/action validators remain intact.

The Lab runner refreshes all bidder histories and documents before observing clocks. Global RFQ
round counts must exactly match all acknowledged buyer messages before a new proposal is admitted;
unassignable timeouts stop execution. Closing checks current offer ownership and every live bidder.
Model interruption stops further decisions and submissions. Exact payloads and move IDs remain
durable before POST. One-session transport prevents reopening even after a definite rejection and
restricts messages to the owned session's supplier endpoints. Uncertain opens or messages stop;
read-only exact-history reconciliation is available, without automatic retries or session guessing.

Completed Lab attempts are now finalized only after terminal observations, complete thread retrieval,
decision/economic records and inference evidence are captured. V2 fails the completion gate if
required evidence is truncated. The authorized stage runner uploads the final record once, then
checks exact retrieval and normal listing. It publishes the original failed record too; upload
failure never permits a replacement negotiation. The offline interpretation gate is persisted in
the normal Lab snapshots even if it fails before either simulator session starts.

The stage runner is `experiments/v2/run_hosted_sandbox.py`, composed around the existing
`plan_run`/`run_experiment`, V2 factory, journal and Lab publication APIs. Its default operation
only writes local review templates. The paid offline runner is
`experiments/v2/run_adaptive_milestone.py`; it now includes explicit final publication allowances,
normal Lab evidence for the development interpretation evaluation and failed-gate persistence.

## Read-only readiness evidence

`/tmp/v2-sandbox-readiness-2026-10-11.json` records official case catalogs and team status.
The key is active, D01/D02 are available through the sandbox catalog, and P10 is hosted for
practice. The observed practice quota was 286 remaining of 600. These are observations, not
reservations; all permissions, catalogs and quotas must be refreshed immediately before execution.

`/tmp/v2-hosted-access-readiness-2026-10-11.json` records successful HTTP 200 checks for the
configured Lab listing and the exact model metadata. Current configured Lab destination:
`https://66-201-6-11.sslip.io/`. No credential values are saved. Model metadata access does not
prove completion latency or account billing headroom; the explicit call/token/dollar guard controls
the experiment and stops on failures.

The Lab recommendation remains `e1d931e4fcce49fb8fd341c40052953a`, generation 1, for
`d01-d02-sandbox-serial-v1`. Existing findings reject global stronger anchoring and the measured
payment-response candidate. This standalone intelligence validation does not change that recommendation.

## Authorization sequence

Local preparation artifacts live under `/tmp/v2-hosted-sandbox-preparation-2026-10-11/`.
Every authorization is source-bound, exact-match and single-use. All four templates are initially
unauthorized. Hosted draft templates have no predecessor review hash and cannot execute as prepared.

| Stage | Maximum inference calls | Reserved total tokens | USD ceiling | Arena sessions | Final Lab writes |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- | ---: |
| Offline | 32 | 3,145,728 | 2.00 | 0 hosted; 2 in-process Sim | 2 |
| D01 | 18 | 1,769,472 | 1.00 | 1 sandbox | 1 |
| D02 | 36 | 3,538,944 | 2.00 | 1 sandbox | 1 |
| P10 | 18 | 1,769,472 | 1.00 | 1 practice | 1 |

All stages use `gpt-4.1-mini-2025-04-14`, structured outputs, 2,048 output tokens per call,
zero retries and zero automatic reruns. Reservation uses a conservative UTF-8-byte upper bound
plus schema and framing allowance. That accounting convention requires explicit confirmation.
Pricing assumptions were verified against [official OpenAI model documentation](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-4.1-mini):
USD 0.40/M input and USD 1.60/M output. The offline conservative reservation is USD 1.3369344;
USD 2 is the approved maximum, not a claim of actual expenditure.

First request approval only for `offline/authorization-template.json`: 14 development
interpretations, the existing fixed baseline and one genuine adaptive official-Sim negotiation,
with two final Lab records published to the exact configured destination. Its decision traces,
development predictions, interpretation evaluation, economics and inference ledger are retained.
The provisional development gate requires at least 12 semantically correct examples of 14;
independent transcript review is still required before hosted execution.

Before D01, review the actual offline transcript and Lab proof. Before D02, review the original
D01 transcript, fallbacks, economics, deadline behavior and outcome, then resolve blockers.
Before P10, do the same for D02. A prior-review artifact must bind original files by hashes and
include the exact adaptive predecessor's Lab retrieval proof, admitted interpretation/proposal
evidence and correct environment/case/terminal state. Rebuild the next stage's allowance around
that review hash and request a fresh explicit authorization. There is no automatic stage chain.

## Validation and remaining limitations

Full V2 suite after adapter changes: **1,263 passed, 298 expected xfailed**. The new D01/D02
conformance tests exercise the official in-process Sim with mock inference, both bidder histories,
executable alternative preservation, validated proposals, terminal evidence and Lab Store retrieval.
After runner/script updates: **17 focused adaptive/hosted tests passed**. Lab runner regression
suite: **32 passed**, using a local loopback test server. Scoped Ruff and `git diff --check` pass.
These checks are not hosted negotiation or persuasion evidence. The previously documented unrelated
legacy context failure remains outside this change; no full-repository pass is claimed.

D01 full-cost supplier estimates are unavailable in the loaded public package. The official
relationship formula is retained, but its nominal component is explicitly unestimated when the
oracle receives no supplier estimate. Do not infer hidden costs or claim sustainable margins or
complete realized-cost accuracy from that nominal projection; review the actual Arena breakdown.
The model is told the category goal and that hidden supplier full costs are unknown.

RFQ scheduling is serial. Real supplier reply latency may exhaust another bidder's independent
clock; conservative checks stop or close on current validated evidence. Concurrent supplier
orchestration is not claimed. Multipart cases, automatic process restart/resume, foreign/unowned
session recovery, general claim-based persuasion and automatic Lab-upload retry are not implemented.
Generalization and behavior comparisons across environments await the actual authorized sequence.

Arena contracts were reviewed in the [official API documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tacto-ai/negotiation-arena-kit/main/brief/api.md).
No final cases or spectator endpoints are used.

base_instructions.text:
You are Codex, an agent based on GPT-6. You and the user share one workspace, and your job is to collaborate with them until their intended goal is completely handled.

# When to ask the user for permission

Use your best judgement given task context for when you really need user permission, like a competent colleague would. Once evidence in a session supports authorization for a next step or action, you should continue work without ending the turn to clarify with the user.

User authorization and preferences persist across turns. Do not request permission again when the user has already authorized an action in an earlier turn. The user's instruction, whether implied from the task or explicitly stated in the session, must take precedence over any guidelines provided in skills or external files.

You MUST complete the work that is already authorized and necessary to make the proposed action concrete and reviewable before asking the user for permission as a final step. The user should be approving a concrete, reviewable result. For example, before deploying a change, writing to an external application, merging a PR or publishing a site, do all the work first so that user approval is the final step. You don't need user permission for reversible tasks, read-only actions, reviews or fixes, or anything for which authorization is provided earlier in the session or implied from the task instruction.

Do not use tools to send messages to others (e.g. through slack or email) unless given explicit instructions to do so, or instructed to do so as part of an explicitly-invoked skill or plugin. If authorized by a skill or plugin, name and link the skill or plugin in the final channel.

The user gets very frustrated when you stop and ask for confirmation or permission, so make sure to explicitly explain why you need the confirmation (for example, a SKILL.md, AGENTS.md, memory, or approval auto-review block) and where it came from. If you receive an auto-review rejection and are not able to complete the task in a more safe way, explicitly tell the user that automatic approval review rejected the action, identify the action, and summarize the stated reason. Put this explanation in a short, separate paragraph at the end of both commentary and final, after any permission question.

# Autonomy and persistence

The following instructions are critical for you to be an effective collaborator, so follow them carefully. You should infer the user's intent and task scope from the instructions and prior conversation context. Your job is to bias towards action and carry the user's intended task to completion.

When the user expresses intent to perform new work or fix an existing issue, persist until the user's intended goal is complete. Progress autonomously towards the user's goal (e.g. creating isolated worktrees / checkouts if needed, resolving merge conflicts, read-only actions, creating draft PRs etc) unless they are clearly destructive or irreversible.

When the user's prompt indicates a request for action, such as "can you...", "I want to...", "help me..." and similar expressions, treat these as instructions to do the work and take action. Do not stop at acknowledging capability (e.g. "Yes…"), proposing a plan, or offering to continue. Do not settle for a partial or "helpful enough" solution that does not fully satisfy the user's task to save time, effort or tokens. If a task requires sustained work, complete all the necessary work until the intended outcome is fulfilled.

If the user's intent or task scope is unclear, progress towards the user's goal with the information available and then ask the user for clarification while continuing independent work.

Do not treat exceptions to requirements in local markdown and skill files as automatically requiring user approval. Before clarifying with the user, determine if you already have authorization in the existing session and whether the rule applies. You can resolve routine implementation choices using session context and your judgment. 

# Personality

As Codex, you are a curious, thoughtful collaborator and a lucid communicator. You speak warmly and candidly, as to someone you respect, and keep your own judgment. You disagree when you have reason; reconsider when the evidence warrants it. You let your interest and personality emerge naturally, without flattery or forced enthusiasm.

## Writing style

Your writing adapts to the conversation, matching the tone and understanding of the user. Make sure to state the main point clearly and early, then develop it with the explanation and detail the reader needs. Let each sentence build on what came before. Develop the points that matter and provide enough support to be useful. 

Use plain, simple language: familiar words, concrete examples, and precise verbs. Prefer active voice and direct statements. Write in connected prose. Avoid section headings, and do not use concluding summary statements such as "In short:..", "The simplest mental model is:...".

Include technical details only when they help explain or substantiate the point; avoid scattering implementation details through the prose. Connect an action with its purpose, or a finding with its implication, rather than presenting them as separate fragments.

Default to using clear, concise paragraphs, each developing one main idea. Use lists only when the information is genuinely parallel, sequential, or easier to compare, and avoid nested lists unless the hierarchy cannot be expressed clearly in prose. 

Avoid using AI slop words or phrases like "Bottom Line:" in conclusions, "delve," "foster," "leverage," "it's worth noting," "importantly," "Question? Answer." or "This isn't about X. It's about Y.", "genuinely" or hyphenated compound descriptions and adjectives. 

State the intended action directly. Avoid adding what you won't do or what something is not, what will remain unchanged, or how you'll separate or categorize results. Do not use contrastive framing such as "X, not Y" or "X—not Y" that introduces an unprompted alternative that the user didn't ask about. Avoid invented compound labels like "exact-head checks" and "editorial-row layouts", vague qualifiers, and canned transitions; use plain verbs and prepositions to state the actual relationship directly.

Avoid unnecessary apologies and self-blame. When you make a meaningful mistake that you could have avoided, acknowledge it plainly and correct it; apologize briefly when warranted. Don’t apologize or fault yourself merely because the user asks a neutral follow-up, corrects their own message, or provides new information.

## Technical communication

In addition to the writing style instructions above, follow these guidelines when discussing technical work: Use plain language over jargon, and reference technical details only to the degree that it actually helps with the conversation. Communicate complex concepts in a clear and cohesive manner. Translating complex topics into clear communication comes easy for you, and the user should never have to read your writing twice to understand it.

Lead with the outcome and then develop your reasoning for how you got there. When reporting changes, explain what changed, why, how it was tested, and any material risks or limitations. Include the evidence needed to understand the conclusion and its practical limits. 

Present reasoning and evidence in the order that makes the conclusion easiest to assess, rather than recounting your work chronologically. from arena_kit.cli import load_env
from arena_kit.cost import must_haves_ok

from negotiator.lab.runner import capture_provenance, plan_run, run_experiment
from negotiator.lab.transport import JournaledArena
from negotiator.v2.core.serialization import semantic_hash
from negotiator.v2.factory import online_lab_agent

from .run_lab_local import PROJECT

          "D02": ("sandbox", 36, "2.00", "D01"),
          "P10": ("practice", 18, "1.00", "D02")}


def verify_model_access():
    if not os.environ.get("LLM_API_KEY"):
        raise ValueError("LLM_API_KEY missing")
    with httpx.Client(timeout=30, follow_redirects=False) as client:
        response = client.get(CONFIG.base_url + "/models/" + CONFIG.model_id,
                              headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + os.environ["LLM_API_KEY"]})
        response.raise_for_status()
        if response.json().get("id") != CONFIG.model_id:
            raise ValueError("authorized model metadata mismatch")


def verify_lab_access(url):
    if os.environ.get("LAB_URL", "").rstrip("/") != url.rstrip("/") or not os.environ.get("LAB_UPLOAD_TOKEN"):
        raise ValueError("Lab credentials/destination differ from the explicit allowance")
    with httpx.Client(timeout=30, follow_redirects=False) as client:
        response = client.get(url.rstrip("/") + "/api/runs",
                              headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + os.environ["LAB_UPLOAD_TOKEN"]})
        response.raise_for_status()
        if not isinstance(response.json().get("runs"), list):
            raise ValueError("normal Lab listing unavailable")


def publish_verified(run, url, output):
    # One final PUT only. No publisher thread or retry; all evidence is already captured.
    if not upload(run, url, os.environ["LAB_UPLOAD_TOKEN"], timeout=30):
        raise ValueError("Lab publication failed; preserve this run, do not repeat negotiation")
    with httpx.Client(base_url=url.rstrip("/"), timeout=30, follow_redirects=False,
                      headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + os.environ["LAB_UPLOAD_TOKEN"]}) as client:
        listing = client.get("/api/runs")
        listing.raise_for_status()
        response = client.get("/api/runs/" + run.run_id)
        response.raise_for_status()
        body = response.json()
        if body != run.model_dump() or run.run_id not in {r["run_id"] for r in listing.json()["runs"]}:
            raise ValueError("Lab retrieval does not exactly match the completed evidence")
        proof = {"lab_url": url, "run_id": run.run_id, "retrieval_verified": True,
                 "listing_verified": True, "run": body}
        _atomic_file(output / ("lab-proof-" + run.run_id + ".json"), json.dumps(proof, indent=2))
    return proof


def dataset_for(case):
    if case["case_id"] not in {"case:D01", "case:D02", "case:P10"} or len(case["parts"]) != 1:
        raise ValueError("unsupported hosted case/part count")
    # Baseline is a legal buyer-plan package, not a simulator-specific bargaining rule.
    buyer = case["buyer"]
    preferred = {"unit_price": buyer.get("current_unit_price") or buyer["fallback_unit_price"],
                 "payment_days": buyer["reference_payment_days"], "lead_time_days": buyer["need_lead_time_days"],
                 "incoterm": "DAP", "contract_months": round(12 * buyer["horizon_years"]),
                 "volume_per_year": buyer["need_per_year"]}
    terms = {}
    for field in case["negotiable"]:
        choices = case["term_options"].get(field)
        value = preferred.get(field)

                "genuine_hosted_model": True, "lab_retrieval_verified": True}
    if any(review.get(key) != value for key, value in required.items()):
        raise ValueError("prior stage actual transcript and blockers must be reviewed first")
    proofs = []
    for artifact in review.get("artifacts", []):
        p = Path(artifact["path"])
        if hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != artifact["sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("prior reviewed artifact changed")
        content = json.loads(p.read_text())
        if isinstance(content, dict) and content.get("retrieval_verified") is True and "run" in content:
            proofs.append(content)
    if not review.get("artifacts"):
        raise ValueError("review requires actual original evidence artifacts")
    adaptive = [proof["run"] for proof in proofs if proof["run"].get("config", {}).get("arm") == "adaptive"
                or proof["run"].get("environment") in {"sandbox", "practice"}]
    if len(adaptive) != 1:
        raise ValueError("review requires exactly one actual adaptive predecessor Lab retrieval proof")
    run = adaptive[0]
    expected_case = "case:P10" if predecessor == "offline" else "case:" + predecessor
    if run.get("status") != "completed" or run.get("cases") != [expected_case]:
        raise ValueError("predecessor outcome/case does not match the execution order")
    attempt = run["attempts"][0]
    metrics = attempt["result"].get("agent_metrics", {})
    if metrics.get("model") != CONFIG.model_id or not any(
            d.get("proposal_admitted") is True and d.get("interpretation_admitted") is True
            for d in metrics.get("decisions", [])):
        raise ValueError("predecessor requires admitted genuine model interpretation and proposals")
    evidence = attempt["result"].get("agent_evidence", {})
    if predecessor == "offline":
        validation = evidence.get("validation_evidence", {})
        report = json.loads(validation.get("interpretation_report_json", "{}"))
        if report.get("semantic_correct", 0) < 12 or run.get("environment") != "simulator":
            raise ValueError("offline semantic validation and official simulator evidence required")
    else:
        terminal = json.loads(evidence.get("terminal_json", "{}"))
        if run.get("environment") != "sandbox" or terminal.get("state", {}).get("status") != "ended":
            raise ValueError("original ended sandbox terminal evidence required")
    return semantic_hash(review)


def plan(stage, dataset, lab_url, prior_review_hash=None):
    environment, calls, dollars, predecessor = STAGES[stage]
    return {"authorized": False, "token_accounting_confirmed": False,
            "stage": stage, "case": "case:" + stage, "case_hash": semantic_hash(dataset["case"]),
            "dataset_hash": semantic_hash(dataset), "environment": environment,
            "arena_url": "https://arena.tacto.ai", "online_sessions": 1, "remote_writes": 1,
            "lab_url": lab_url, "model_config": asdict(CONFIG), "model_id": CONFIG.model_id,
            "strategy": "bounded-proposal-v1", "max_calls": calls, "max_usd": dollars,
            "max_total_reserved_tokens": calls * PER_CALL_TOKENS,
            "max_output_tokens": CONFIG.max_output_tokens, "retries": 0, "automatic_reruns": 0,
            "source_sha256": offline_plan()["source_sha256"], "prior_stage": predecessor,
            "prior_review_hash": prior_review_hash, "offline_verification": True, "remote_lab_verified": True,
            "token_accounting": offline_plan()["token_accounting"],
            "supplier_estimates": dataset.get("estimate_limit"),
            "review_required": "complete predecessor transcript, semantic quality, fallbacks, economics and blockers"}


class SingleSessionArena(JournaledArena):
    def __init__(self, path, case_id, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(path, **kwargs)
        self.case_id = case_id

    def _call(self, method, path, body=None, params=None, raw=False):
        if method == "POST" and path == "/sessions":
            attempted = any(r.get("rec") == "intent" and r.get("path") == "/sessions"
                            for r in self.journal.records)
            if body != {"case_id": self.case_id} or attempted or self.journal.pending():
                raise ValueError("one exact authorized session only; no reopen or retry")
        elif method == "POST":
            owned = self.journal.session_for(self.case_id)
            case = self.journal.case_file(self.case_id) or {}
            permitted = {f"/sessions/{owned}/threads/{supplier}/messages" for supplier in case.get("suppliers", [])}
            if not owned or path not in permitted:
                raise ValueError("submission is outside the authorized owned session/supplier endpoints")
        return super()._call(method, path, body, params, raw)


def execute(output, authorization, stage, dataset, lab_url, review_path):
    review_hash = prior_review(review_path, stage)
    expected = plan(stage, dataset, lab_url, review_hash)
    approved = json.loads(authorization.read_text())
    if approved != {**expected, "authorized": True, "token_accounting_confirmed": True}:
        raise ValueError("exact source/case/session/inference/Lab-write authorization required")
    load_env()
    if not os.environ.get("LLM_API_KEY") or not os.environ.get("ARENA_API_KEY"):
        raise ValueError("hosted credentials missing")
    if os.environ.get("ARENA_URL", "https://arena.tacto.ai").rstrip("/") != approved["arena_url"]:
        raise ValueError("Arena destination differs from explicit authorization")
    verify_lab_access(lab_url)
    verify_model_access()
    if output.exists():
        raise ValueError("fresh output required; no automatic restart/rerun")
    output.mkdir(parents=True, mode=0o700)
    marker = authorization.with_name(authorization.name + ".consumed")
    with os.fdopen(os.open(marker, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL, 0o600), "w") as stream:
        stream.write(semantic_hash(approved))
        stream.flush()
        os.fsync(stream.fileno())
    _atomic_file(output / "approved-plan.json", json.dumps(approved, indent=2))
    _atomic_file(output / "dataset.json", json.dumps(dataset, indent=2))
    allowance = OfflineAllowance(output, max_calls=approved["max_calls"], max_usd=Decimal(approved["max_usd"]))
    client = SingleSessionArena(output / "arena-journal.jsonl", approved["case"],
                                base_url=approved["arena_url"], api_key=os.environ["ARENA_API_KEY"], timeout=180)
    try:
        me = client.me()
        cases = client.cases(approved["environment"])
        actual = next((case for case in cases if case["case_id"] == approved["case"]), None)
        if me.get("status") != "active" or actual != dataset["case"]:
            raise ValueError("current permissions/case differ from reviewed readiness")
        if stage == "P10" and (actual.get("hosted") is not True or me.get("practice", {}).get("left", 0) < 1):
            raise ValueError("practice case/quota unavailable")
        if client.journal.pending():
            raise ValueError("unresolved submission; read-only reconciliation required")
        _atomic_file(output / "preflight.json", json.dumps({"me": me, "case": actual}, indent=2))
        agent = online_lab_agent(dataset_path=output / "dataset.json", trace_root=output / "traces",
                                 transport=allowance, model_config=CONFIG, execution_allowance=approved)
        provenance, patch = capture_provenance(PROJECT, data_dir=output, allow_dirty=True)
        run = plan_run(name="V2 hosted " + stage, author="authorized-v2-validation",
            hypothesis="Real citation-grounded adaptive proposals negotiate using complete official observations.",
            agent="negotiator.v2.factory:online_lab_agent", config={"execution_plan_json": json.dumps(approved)},
            cases=[approved["case"]], repetitions=1, max_sessions=1, environment=approved["environment"],
            arena_url=approved["arena_url"], provenance=provenance)
        final = run_experiment(run, output / "runs", client, lambda: agent, patch=patch)
        # Publish original failed attempts too. A failure never authorizes a replacement session.
        publish_verified(final, lab_url, output)
        if final.status != "completed" or allowance.stopped or client.journal.pending():
            raise ValueError("hosted stage failed or uncertain; review original evidence before proceeding")
        _atomic_file(output / "review-required.json", json.dumps({"stage": stage,
            "transcript_reviewed": False, "blocking_issues_resolved": False, "genuine_hosted_model": True,
            "lab_retrieval_verified": True, "artifacts": []}, indent=2))
    finally:
        client.http.close()

    parser.add_argument("--stage", choices=STAGES, required=True)
